run_type: SOURCE CHANGE - baseline_booking (first run on Booking.com MCP connector; runs 1-3 were Triverna UI scraping)
requirement: breakfast included, cheapest room that fits 3 (extra bed OK)
scope: Fri->Sun weekends, rolling window: nearest Friday (2026-09-04) to +120 days (2026-12-28)
currency: PLN, total gross for 2 nights (Fri + Sat)
headline: Prompt section 3 now mandates the Booking.com MCP connector. Executed. Booking is a DIFFERENT SALES CHANNEL from Triverna, so the numbers below are NOT comparable to runs 1-3 as a price movement - they are a new baseline. Headline finding: Triverna is cheaper than Booking on 15 of 16 bookable Carynska weekends and on 12 of 14 Bachledka weekends. Nothing on Booking clears the 1 200 zl opportunity threshold.

methodology.source: Booking.com MCP connector (accommodations_search), 34 calls, one per hotel per weekend
methodology.meal_plan_test: Ran 2026-11-20/22 for Carynska with and without meal_plan=breakfast_included. Identical price (1309.60). Filter is either non-binding or the cheapest 3-person option already includes breakfast - CANNOT be distinguished from the API response.
methodology.LIMITATION_CRITICAL: The connector returns ONE aggregate 'book' price with NO room name, NO board type, NO extra-bed detail. The three core requirements of this monitor (breakfast included / cheapest room fitting 3 / extra bed) are therefore UNVERIFIABLE from this source. Triverna UI gave all three. This is a real loss of data quality, not a cosmetic one.
methodology.advantage: Speed and reliability. 34 datapoints in ~3 minutes with zero UI drift, zero counter-settling race condition, zero coordinate guessing. Runs 1-3 needed 50-70s per price read and produced one systematic misread.
methodology.recommendation: Run BOTH. Booking as the fast weekly sweep for availability and gross direction; Triverna as the price-of-record and booking channel, spot-checked only on weekends that Booking flags as interesting.

carynska.name: Carynska Resort & SPA, Dwernik (Bieszczady)
carynska.room: UNKNOWN - connector does not disclose room or board
carynska.structural_observation: In the low season (6.11 onwards) the Booking premium is a FLAT +199.60 zl on every single weekend - six identical spreads. A constant offset that precise implies the same underlying room and rate plan with a fixed channel markup. In Sep/Oct the spread is erratic (+2.6% to +73.7%), which implies Booking is surfacing a DIFFERENT, more expensive room in high season. Treat Sep/Oct Booking numbers as weakly comparable at best.
carynska.availability: 2026-12-25 unavailable - matches Triverna (offer window ends 22.12). No other gaps.

This run cannot confirm or deny a Triverna repricing because it did not touch Triverna. If you care about that question, the next run must hit Triverna directly - the Booking connector will never see it.

Decide the source of record. Booking is fast and reliable but cannot verify breakfast, room type, or extra bed - the three things this monitor was built to check. Recommend: Booking weekly for availability and direction, Triverna spot-check on flagged weekends only.

Carynska Sep/Oct Booking prices look like a different (pricier) room than the standard+dostawka. Verify one date - e.g. 2-4.10, where the spread is +73.7% - against Triverna before trusting high-season Booking numbers.
